bio: Home Faculty Directory J.D., Boston College, (2003) Debbie Goldstein is currently a lecturer on law at Harvard Law School, and a principal and the managing director of Triad Consulting, an organization focused on helping people resolve disputes. Goldstein works domestically and internationally with clients in the profit, nonprofit, and government realms. In the public sector, she founded and ran a free legal aid clinic called LINC (Legal Initiative for Children) for the patients at Massachusetts General Hospital's Chelsea outpost. Goldstein received her B.A. from Williams College, and her J.D. from Boston College Law School. Email deborah_goldstein@gse.harvard.edu Office Hours Email the Faculty Member
